name: punk-cover
title_zh: 同一套朋克视觉库，文章、小红书、公众号封面一次生成
tagline_zh: 每篇文章都要封面，找图配字最耗时。11 种精调风格（商业杂志头版、复古手撕拼贴、巨型透视中文标题…），每种都标了适合什么内容。
tagline_en: Turn any article, note or tweet into a cover image in one line — 11 finely tuned styles (magazine front page, torn-paper collage, giant Chinese title…) for Xiaohongshu, WeChat and X.
desc_en: Generate cover images and reusable image prompts from the shared Punk style library for articles, Xiaohongshu notes, WeChat public account posts, X posts, topic drafts, and requests for covers, social cover images, poster prompts, style-template-based image prompts, or image generation from long-form text. Use this skill to analyze source content, confirm platform/aspect ratio and visual style, sa
why_zh: 风格库真下过功夫：选风格像点菜一样准，出的封面有编辑部气质而不是 AI 糊图。
why_en: The style library is genuinely crafted — each one tagged with what content it fits, so picking feels like ordering off a menu; covers land with editorial polish, not AI mush.
limit_zh: 没告诉它平台和风格，它就停在提问那一步，不会先出一版给你看。预置比例只有小红书 3:4、公众号 2.35:1、X 5:2；一次一张、不给多版对比，也不许两种风格混用。
limit_en: Without a platform and a style it stops at the question and won't draft anything first. Preset ratios cover only Xiaohongshu 3:4, WeChat 2.35:1 and X 5:2. One image per run — no side-by-side options, and mixing two styles is forbidden.
title_en: One punk style library, covers for articles, XHS, WeChat, X
